cards.title: Counting with a dictionary
cards.body: Use each letter as a key and its count as the value. `d.get(key, 0)` gives the value, or 0 when the key is missing.

hi.title: Dictionary se ginna
hi.body: Har letter ko key aur uski ginti ko value banao. `d.get(key, 0)` value deta hai, ya key na ho toh 0.

cards.title: Keys in order
cards.body: `sorted(d)` gives the keys in order: alphabetical for strings.

hi.title: Order mein keys
hi.body: `sorted(d)` keys ko order mein deta hai: strings ke liye alphabetical.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should count each letter, but crashes with a `KeyError` on the very first one. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: A new letter is not in the dictionary yet. `counts.get(ch, 0) + 1` starts it at 0.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse har letter ginna chahiye, par yeh pehle letter par hi `KeyError` dekar crash hota hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Naya letter abhi dictionary mein nahi hai. `counts.get(ch, 0) + 1` use 0 se shuru karta hai.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: p appears twice in "pop", so its count is 2.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: "pop" mein p do baar aata hai, isliye uski ginti 2 hai.

exercise.prompt: Read a word in lowercase letters and print how many times each letter appears, one per line as `letter count`, in alphabetical order.
exercise.promptHi: Lowercase letters ka ek word padho aur print karo ki har letter kitni baar aata hai, har line mein `letter count`, alphabetical order mein.
